messages:
alex_g: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A about infra/capacity — thanks for the overview :wave:
alex_g: two quick clarifying Qs: 1) GPU procurement timeline (A100s/RTX series?) 2) autoscale warm pools vs instant burst — how will that affect latency for bursty traffic?

mike_vp_infra: short answers: procurement: mostly A100 and H100 mix for Dedicated; some T4/RTX for cheap embedding nodes. Shipments are staggered — expect two waves this quarter.
mike_vp_infra: autoscale: we’re keeping a small warm pool per-region + per-tenant for Dedicated; burst uses preemptible capacity in cloud regions for Hosted. That means 99th pct latency should hold in normal bursts, but extreme >10x spikes will see failover to smaller, faster model variants.

chen_sre: to add — warm pools are configurable by policy (min_instances), default will be 2 per-AZ for Dedicated. We measure warm pool hit-rates in the console dashboard.

priya_product: are regions gated by supply? any EMEA/APAC delays we should call out to customers?
mike_vp_infra: yes slightly staggered. EMEA racks get second-wave shipments ~3–4 weeks after NA. APAC depends on partner datacenter availability; we’ll be explicit on region availability in the status page and when customers try to reserve Dedicated capacity.

maya_ceo: note for comms: call out expected delays and autoscale behavior in the customer-facing docs this week. We want to avoid surprises during PLG signups.

alex_g: good. can we get a concise FAQ blurb? PR to docs or a short pinned message in #product-support?
mike_vp_infra: will post a short FAQ tonight. Draft bullet points: - Regions: NA first, EU next, APAC pilot. - GPUs: A100/H100 for high-throughput, T4/RTX for embeddings + fallbacks. - Autoscale: warm pools + preemptible burst, fallback to quantized variants for extreme spikes.

opsbot: [deploy-bot] new autoscaler rollout scheduled: canary to 10% of Dedicated clusters at 2026-06-12T02:00Z. Monitor: autoscale_events, latency_p99, cold_start_rate.

chen_sre: small config snippet for teams who want to preview behavior (example policy):
```
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  burst_budget: 30% # percent of cluster usable for preemptible burst
  cold_start_timeout_ms: 120
```

alex_g: perfect, that helps. one more: how will this affect pricing for Dedicated commits? any change expected?
mike_vp_infra: pricing flat for committed capacity. autoscale burst is billed differently (metered at burst rates). We’ll add a calculator in the console to estimate burst costs based on historical traffic.

priya_product: can we surface a note in the signup flow: "Expected region availability and autoscale behavior"? ops to make a short checkbox blurb.
mike_vp_infra: yes, adding to the signup UX backlog.

maya_ceo: thanks — can infra share a one-pager by EOD Friday so we can make the support brief?
mike_vp_infra: yes — will share by Friday EOD.

alex_g: ack, thanks all. will pin mike’s FAQ once posted. :thumbsup:

chen_sre: fyi — I’ll create a small alert on paging thresholds if cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m during rollouts.

opsbot: [alert] paging rule created: cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m -> page oncall SRE.

alex_g: excellent. that should keep rollouts safe.

priya_product: ping me when the FAQ draft is up and I’ll adapt for customer comms.
mike_vp_infra: will do — thanks everyone.
